At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.
As the API Product Lead at Harvey, you'll own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Harvey's APIs: the way law firms and in-house legal teams integrate with and build on top of Harvey’s platform.
You'll turn customer demand into a product that customers can adopt, build on, and capture value from.
You'll balance new capabilities against the reliability, security, and scale that production builds on Harvey require.
You'll define and drive the product vision and roadmap for Harvey's APIs, aligned with company strategy and grounded in evidence from customers, usage data, and the market.
You'll work closely with engineering, solutions architects, and go-to-market teams to ship, and you'll own the outcomes: adoption and production usage.
Day to day, you will own planning, prioritization, and roadmapping.
You'll make and communicate crisp prioritization decisions, balancing new capabilities against reliability, performance, and security.
You'll define the metrics that matter, including who is building on Harvey, what they are building, how much they use, and hold the team accountable to them.

You'll be the connective tissue between customers building on Harvey, the teams who support them, and engineering, and you'll raise the product bar through rigorous specs, reviews, and decision-making.
